finishes.note: Floor slabs 1.20 along the hall x 0.80 across, grid unstaggered, a joint on the axis, 2.5 mm joints (as built); vein-cut, the bands running east-west along the hall (Story: bands along the direction of travel); voids filled flush with tinted resin, polished to a soft reflection of the glass and garden; dulled in the walking line.
The five flush viewing-stone discs (R 0.400 top), one piece each, cut across the floor's bands.
Flush rings R 0.400-0.450 in the discs' rebates; grain round the ring; kept bright by feet.
Plinths under the glass, 0.36 x 0.40 section, ashlar up to 1.80 long; the half outside the glass line takes the outdoor surface law (wetting and soiling where it sees the sky).
The 20 step-light pockets in the plinths' inner faces, hidden behind the luminaires' louvres.
Planter kerbs outside the glass (|y| 4.68-4.80), blocks up to 1.80: outdoors, honed, weathered by the museum's weather.

The two 50 mm end linings (west R 11.20-11.25 about the Rotunda's axis, east R 14.80-14.85 about the Atrium's), cladding courses 0.60 high, slabs up to 1.80 long; the east one's band round the lunette.
Hidden rough-opening faces through the two linings (the joint's linings cover them).
The four stereo drums, one block each; the top's polish dulled by hands leaning on it.
The walls' steel: 20 posts (the mullions), 4 end posts, glazing shoes, transoms and the box eaves. The posts' pressure caps and the eaves' outer faces take the outdoor surface law.
The vault's steel: 18 arches, 7 purlin lines, 136 crosses, 2 collars and the 5 lunette mullions.
Wall panes: Optiwhite 8 + 1.52 UV-filtering PVB + 8 (17.52 mm), 22 panes; outer faces weathered by the museum's weather.
Vault panes: the same laminate, heat-strengthened, hot-bent to R 5.30; 152 panes; rain runs and snow lies on the outer faces.
The six flat lunette panes in the east lining over the Atrium's coping.
The prints' flat stems (32) and their shoes on the plinth; grain vertical.
The autochromes' glazing bars (8), shoe to transom.
The four reader plates 0.68 x 0.40 x 0.03 and their Ø 0.030 stems; the plate's rim bright where hands rest.

The thin dark photograph frames, 22 mm moulding: round each print's 1.0 x 0.9 mount (outer 1.044 x 0.944) and round each autochrome's mat; also the autochrome cassettes' timber. Art builds the frames.
The prints' pale mounts 1.000 x 0.900 x 0.030: museum board faced on a rigid core; the print sits on it, centred, under the frame's glazing.
The autochromes' white window mats 1.000 x 0.900, bevel-cut round each plate.
The diffusing pane behind each autochrome (between plate and wall glass): the garden's daylight lights the plate evenly from behind.
Glazing in the photograph frames and over the four stereo cards: UV-filtering laminate with anti-reflective faces.
Closed pair of cast CuSn10 leaves filling the west class opening on the port face, while hall-of-light.west is unmated (on the stand).
Closed pair of cast CuSn10 leaves filling the east class opening on the port face, while hall-of-light.east is unmated (tonight, until the Atrium is built).
